text:
[LCNT.2.3] Applying the gate to a concrete proposal: name the closed
operations the grouping offers, confirm each is bounded-cost, and
confirm none hands the author a way to iterate. Where the proposal's
value *is* iteration, it belongs across the adapter boundary
([LCNT.6.1]), not in the language.

For signal processing the same question reads: which fixed transform or
reduction — and which incremental backing realises it — joins the
algebra? Never: how does an author walk samples?
